code:
let TimeWindow = 1h;
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| join kind=inner (
    SigninLogs
    | where ResultType == "0"
    | extend Country2 = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
  ) on UserPrincipalName
| where TimeGenerated2 > TimeGenerated
| where Country != Country2
| where (TimeGenerated2 - TimeGenerated) < TimeWindow
caption: A self-join on UserPrincipalName — two successful sign-ins, two countries, under an hour apart.
